ability.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.explosive_: Arm your fist: the next blow that lands within 8 seconds - on a mob, a player or a block - explodes at the point of contact. A swing at the air keeps it armed. Grows with mastery to about the size of TNT.

Needs the Bomb Pistol in either hand, its cylinder blown full of your breath (hold right-click: open, spin, blow, shut). The shot is invisible - only the air it drives shows - and explodes powerfully where it hits. Right-clicking the loaded pistol fires it too.
The cylinder is empty - hold right-click to blow into it
You need the Bomb Pistol in hand
The cylinder holds plain air - blow into it yourself
ability.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.nose_fancy: Flicks one booger from the nose. The sticky blob clings to whatever it touches and explodes a moment later. 15 seconds of cooldown.
ability.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.self_destr: Hold to charge, release to explode your whole body: a pulse, a blast, or - fully charged - the biggest explosion you can make. Your body vanishes into the blast, untouchable for a moment, and reforms on the spot. Long cooldown, heavy energy cost.
ability.devilfruits.debug_logia.drift.de: The elemental body drifts forward for a second.
ability.devilfruits.debug_logia.pulse.de: The arms turn into the element for half a second.
ability.devilfruits.debug_zoan.breath.de: Channelled while the key is held.
ability.devilfruits.debug_zoan.strike.de: Instant hit; stronger variant in beast form.
ability.devilfruits.debug_zoan.transform: Switch to the beast form and back.
ability.devilfruits.doru_doru.candle_cha: Build a giant suit of wax round yourself: huge fists swing wide, long falls end in a stomp. Faster, stronger, longer reach. The suit has its own integrity - heat burns it three times as fast - and melts away when it runs out.
ability.devilfruits.doru_doru.candle_ser: Raise a giant candle stand; its flames shed wax flakes over everyone in the open round it. Whoever stands still is coated faster and faster until encased in wax. A roof keeps the flakes off; fire strips the coating. It burns down, and fire destroys it.
ability.devilfruits.doru_doru.candle_wal: Slam your palms down: a ribbed wall of wax rises where you look, slightly bowed towards the enemy. Crouch to raise a dome round yourself instead. Stops arrows and explosions; heat melts it. Lasts 45 seconds, three at a time.
ability.devilfruits.doru_doru.wax_atelie: Sculpt Mode: wax flows from your hands into the shape you design and sets. Shapes (walls, domes, arches, bridges, spirals...), a brush that adds, carves, smooths and dyes, casts of anything you see, mirror and radial symmetry, undo. Heavy parts need support. Costs energy per block.
A huge lance of wax. Tap: a long thrust that runs through a line of enemies. Hold: throw it - stuck in a wall it stays as a wax peg to climb on. Every hit coats the target with wax.
Pick a tool from a small wheel - pickaxe, shovel, axe, hoe or sword - and it sets in your hand out of wax: fast as gold, strong as iron, never wearing out - except in heat. It cannot be dropped or stored and melts away when you put it down.
ability.devilfruits.gura_gura.gekishin.d: A short wind-up and a lunging close-range punch. The target is launched like a cannonball and bursts the ground where it lands.
ability.devilfruits.gura_gura.kabutowari: Leap and slam both fists down: radial fissures race over the ground, tearing up blocks and throwing everything into the air.
ability.devilfruits.gura_gura.kaishin.de: Hold to draw your fist back inside a bubble of cracked air, release to shatter the air into a cone-shaped shockwave. A full charge tears up the ground.
ability.devilfruits.gura_gura.kaisho.des: Strike the air with both fists. Near water a giant tsunami crashes forward; on land a rolling ground wave erupts.
ability.devilfruits.gura_gura.quake_infu: With a sword, axe, trident or the Bisento: release a crescent of cracked air that flies forward and cuts through everything.
ability.devilfruits.gura_gura.shima_yura: Grab the air and twist it. The sky cracks, the island tilts and everything around you quakes. Requires great mastery.
ability.devilfruits.gura_gura.shindo.des: Toggle: your body vibrates. Projectiles shatter or bounce off, and your melee hits carry a bonus quake. Drains energy.
ability.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.one_kilo.d: Toggle: your weight falls smoothly to 1 kg; press again to return to normal. Jumps of up to 50 blocks, a slow drifting fall, gliding with jump held, strong air control - but hits and explosions fling you far.
ability.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.ten_thousa: Toggle: your weight rises smoothly to 10,000 kg; press again to return. You fall fast, cannot be knocked back, crack the ground with every step and smash through floors and walls. Switched on in the air, you plunge straight down into a crushing shockwave.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.barjan.des: A sweep of the sand arm flings a wide crescent of sand that flies through everything, knocking it back and drying it out.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.desert_enc: Seize whoever is right in front of you: they are held up in a prison of sand while you draw the moisture out of them (hold).
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.desert_gir: A hand in the ground: where you look, a huge funnel of whirling sand opens and drags everything on it into its quicksand throat. Hold to keep it turning.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.desert_la_: Blades of solid sand form over your shoulder and are flung in a fan. More blades with mastery.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.desert_spa: The sand hand slams into the ground and a blade of sand runs along it, splitting the earth and throwing aside whoever stands in its way.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.ground_sec: A palm flat on the ground: while you hold, the land around dries and cracks - soil to sand, plants wither, water evaporates - and whoever stands on it dries out.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.sables.des: Ultimate: a huge sandstorm rises where you look and goes on a rampage - dragging everything in, tearing up the ground and drying the land.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.sables_pes: Dense whirling sand hurled from the hand. Tap for a quick blast; hold to pack a heavy ball that bursts into a shockwave.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.sand_cloud: Become a drifting cloud of sand and fly where you look: jump to rise, sneak to sink, sprint to hurry. Drains Sand Energy while active.
ability.devilfruits.suna_suna.sand_tsuna: The land heaves while you charge; release to roll a towering wave of sand over it that sweeps everything away and dries the land.
ability.devilfruits.supa_supa.blade_skat: Toggle: skate blades unfold from your soles. Skate fast with momentum, carve the turns, sneak to brake, jumps keep the speed. Attack while skating to lunge with arm blades - the faster you go, the harder it hits.
Combo of three. 1-2: your fingers and inner arms turn to blades and rake the air in front (from mastery 6 the cut runs on into what stands behind the target). 3, Atomic Spar: long blades on shoulders and forearms, crossed in an X and thrown open - an X cut that slices through blocks.
ability.devilfruits.supa_supa.spiral_hol: Hold (up to 4 s): your forearms become rings of spinning blades, held out like a drill. Rapid hits in a cone in front, a short boring advance, and the blocks right in front are shredded.
ability.devilfruits.supa_supa.steel_body: Hold: your whole body turns to steel. Blows deal almost nothing, nothing knocks you back, arrows bounce off. You move very slowly and use no other technique; energy drains every second and with every blow. Haki and seastone still hurt.
ability.devilfruits.supa_supa.super_slas: Charge with your arms raised, release to cut down: a tall flying cut of light travels forward, piercing everything, cutting a slit through the ground and walls and destroying projectiles. A ship it meets is cut clean in two along its planks - without breaking a single block.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.blast_b: Hold to gather fire in your mouth, release to breathe it out. Human: a short burst. Hybrid: a beam you steer with your view. Dragon: a colossal, long beam.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.bolo_br: Dragon: spit fire into the sky - a moment later meteors rain down on the area you look at.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.draconi: Crouch while fire gathers at your wrists and tail, then launch in a fast arc onto the enemy you aim at (or the ground ahead), trailing a ribbon of flame, and slam down: everything there is stunned and the floor bursts apart under a pillar of flame.

Leap high, spin and hurl your body down in a colossal smash: a fire shockwave tears a crater into the ground, stuns and flings away everything around. Under Thunderclad Veil violet lightning races out with it.
Whirl round once: your burning tail sweeps the half circle in front of you from left to right and hurls away everything it hits.

Hold with your arms raised: thick violet lightning strikes all around you again and again - on the enemies near you, else into the ring round you - tearing up the floor and whirling the debris round you. The longer you hold, the more strikes (6 to 18). Let go to slam your fists down in a burst of violet light.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.dragon_: A very fast lunge along your view, ramming everything in the way, with a dragon-shaped streak of light behind you.
Hold: the dragon winds its body into a spinning spiral and raises a vortex of wind and lightning that pulls in, lifts and batters everything around, ripping up the ground. Let go to fling it all out.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.flame_c: Ride a burst of burning cloud forward, striking and igniting everything in the way. The clouds keep burning for a moment.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.hellfir: Hold: a burst of fire, then your body lifts off and drifts after the nearest enemy in front, spinning inside rings of fire with a lance of light thrust ahead. Whatever is caught in the rings is held there and burned again and again (up to 49 hits in 3.5 s). Let go and the rings collapse into an explosion.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.roar.de: A shockwave roar that blows back everything in front of you, leaves it slowed and weakened, and blows arrows away.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.serpent: Toggle: soar through the sky (steer with your view, hold Boost for speed) or slither along the ground.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.tail_wh: First press: the tail whips round in a wide arc, flinging everything it sweeps through. Press again: the body coils around the nearest enemy in front, holds it and crushes it.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.thunder: A heavy swing that bursts into a cone and a ring of lightning where it lands. Hybrid: a massive slam with ground cracks, and thunder arcs that jump between nearby mobs.
Summon a storm cloud that follows you: lightning strikes the enemies under it again and again (the ground when there are none).

Gather your power in a black cocoon of thunder that bursts into a violet aura: for a while you deal 10% more damage and take 25% less. Thunderclaw Rush strikes with lightning while it lasts. Press again to end it.

Lunge onto the enemy you aim at (or the nearest in front) and rake it with three claws: a fire burst that stuns it, spinning rings that lift it, a smoking blow that throws it away. Under Thunderclad Veil the claws are violet thunder, and if all three land a pillar of lightning falls on the target.
ability.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.transfo: Transform into Seiryu, the gigantic azure dragon (takes a moment, needs room). Drains Dragon Energy.

Transform into the dragon-man (takes a moment). From the Azure Dragon: shrink back into the Hybrid. The Hybrid does not burn; Shift + hold Space charges a leap of up to 30 blocks (hold W / A / S / D at the release to leap that way).

fruit.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.info1: A Paramecia: any part of your body can explode - a fist, a flicked booger, a bullet you touch, the whole body.
fruit.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.info2: No explosion hurts or pushes you - TNT, creepers, fireballs, other bombers. Seastone and deep water take that away with the rest of the power.
fruit.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.info3: Explosive Shot needs the Bomb Pistol: some journeyman weaponsmiths sell one, treasure chests rarely hold one. It fires your breath, not bullets.
fruit.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.lore1: It smells faintly of gunpowder, and its stem fizzes like a fuse.
fruit.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.lore2: Whoever eats it becomes a bomb that no explosion can hurt.
fruit.devilfruits.bomu_bomu.message.awak: Your body hums like a lit fuse!
Every part of you could explode now, and no blast will ever hurt you... but the sea will never accept you again.

fruit.devilfruits.doru_doru.info1: A Paramecia: your body makes wax and shapes it - tools, walls, lances, whole buildings, a giant suit of armour.

fruit.devilfruits.doru_doru.info3: Honeycomb, candles and wax lumps give energy back (right-click). Seastone and deep water take the power away as always.
fruit.devilfruits.doru_doru.lore1: Its skin is warm and soft, and a cap of white wax runs down from the stem.
fruit.devilfruits.doru_doru.lore2: Whoever eats it makes wax harder than steel - and fears the heat forever.

fruit.devilfruits.gura_gura.info1: One of the Devil Fruits of the Paramecia type. Its eater becomes a Tremor Human, able to create vibrations - quakes - in the air, the ground and the sea.
fruit.devilfruits.gura_gura.info2: Only one exists in the world. When its user dies, the fruit is reborn somewhere nearby.
fruit.devilfruits.gura_gura.info3: Eating a second Devil Fruit tears the body apart. And the sea rejects every Devil Fruit user.
fruit.devilfruits.gura_gura.lore1: Said to hold the power to destroy the world.
fruit.devilfruits.gura_gura.lore2: Its eater can shatter the very air.

fruit.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.info1: A Paramecia: your body weighs anything from 1 kg to 10,000 kg, changing smoothly. Everything follows the weight - gravity, jumps, speed, knockback.
fruit.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.info2: Light, you leap fifty blocks and drift down, but every blow flings you. Heavy, you crush the ground, sink rafts and smash through floors.
fruit.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.info3: Energy drains the further you are from your normal weight; when it runs out you return to 70 kg. You never take fall damage.
fruit.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.lore1: Strangely heavy in one hand, light as a feather in the other.
fruit.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.lore2: Whoever eats it can weigh anything from one kilo to ten tonnes.
fruit.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.message.awak: Your body turns light as a feather... then heavy as iron!
You feel every kilogram of yourself and could change it at will... but the sea will never accept you again.
fruit.devilfruits.kilo_kilo.message.powe: Your weight is your own again. The fruit has reincarnated somewhere nearby...

fruit.devilfruits.suna_suna.info1: A Logia: the body is sand. Blows, arrows, blasts and falls pass through it for free; water makes the sand wet and solid, seastone seals it.
fruit.devilfruits.suna_suna.info2: The sand draws the moisture out of everything: soil turns to sand, plants wither, water dries up, and the living are left Dehydrated.
fruit.devilfruits.suna_suna.info3: Sand Energy recovers faster on sand and in deserts, slower in rain and wet lands. Y turns the whole body into sand, U is the Reform Step.
fruit.devilfruits.suna_suna.lore1: Its rind is dry and gritty, like sun-baked sand.
fruit.devilfruits.suna_suna.lore2: Whoever eats it becomes sand itself.
fruit.devilfruits.suna_suna.message.awak: Your body crumbles into sand... and gathers again!
Dry wind fills your lungs and grains whisper under your skin... but the sea will never accept you again.
fruit.devilfruits.suna_suna.message.powe: The sand scatters to the wind. The fruit has reincarnated somewhere nearby...

fruit.devilfruits.supa_supa.info1: A Paramecia: any part of your body becomes a steel blade - claws, long arm blades, spinning saw rings, skates under your feet.
fruit.devilfruits.supa_supa.info2: Turn your whole body to steel and blows barely scratch you; but the sea, seastone and Haki still cut through.
fruit.devilfruits.supa_supa.info3: At mastery 8 the Super Slash: a tall flying cut that slices through everything - even a ship, clean in two.
fruit.devilfruits.supa_supa.lore1: Three pale pods, cold and smooth as polished steel.
fruit.devilfruits.supa_supa.lore2: Whoever eats it can turn any part of the body into a blade.
fruit.devilfruits.supa_supa.message.awak: A cold edge runs along your arms... your body is a blade!
Every part of you can turn to steel at will... but the sea will never accept you again.
fruit.devilfruits.supa_supa.message.powe: The steel leaves your body. The fruit has reincarnated somewhere nearby...

fruit.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.info1: A Mythical Zoan. Its eater can turn into a hulking dragon-man and into Seiryu, a gigantic azure dragon that flies through the clouds.
fruit.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.info2: Human form at first; the Hybrid form unlocks at mastery 3, the Azure Dragon at mastery 6. Transforming takes a moment.
fruit.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.info3: The dragon burns Dragon Energy while it flies. When the energy runs out it falls back into human form - and drifts down safely.
fruit.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.lore1: Scales of azure swirl over its skin.
fruit.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.lore2: Whoever eats it becomes the strongest creature.
fruit.devilfruits.uo_uo_seiryu.message.a: The Azure Dragon awakens within you!
